text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After completing a training session, Yaeno Muteki and I notice Bamboo Memory running by.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah, Bamboo. You seem to be in a hurry. Are you going somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Nope, I'm on patrol! There have been reports lately of a student breaking curfew to run around the school grounds.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: According to eyewitnesses, the culprit gives off a bright white glow. That sounds pretty unusual, so it shouldn't take me long to track them down!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The problem is that she's incredibly fast! Apparently, as soon as someone spots her, she vanishes in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Are you sure you're dealing with a student, and not some manner of apparition?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: An apparition? Actually, you might be onto something there…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But if we are dealing with an apparition, that's all the more reason to get this case closed! We'll have a school crisis on our hands if everyone's too scared to attend classes!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Agreed. There are many young and vulnerable students here. If I don't look out for them, who will?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm going to accompany Bamboo in her pursuit of this spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not quite sure where this is all going, but at least Yaeno Muteki seems eager to keep running.
choice_data_list: Find out who or what the culprit really is!
If you wait around here, they should come running past at some point, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Time to recommence my patrol! I don't care if it's a ghost or who knows what—if something's causing a disruption at school, it's getting no mercy from me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The time Yaeno Muteki spends running around the school grounds with Bamboo Memory ends up doubling as a good training session for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Incidentally, I hear that they failed to locate any kind of apparition, instead finding only an Umamusume named Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Remarkable insight. Indeed, the culprit has been circling the school buildings.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's set up a checkpoint right here and lie in wait!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll stay with you. Should the spirit become unruly, I will step in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, the specter is a no-show, and only an Umamusume named Agnes Tachyon makes an appearance. At the very least, though, we avoid any overexertion.
